# BloodNet

A blood donation tracking system that follows each unit of blood from donation to transfusion or discard.

Built as a layered Jakarta EE application on Quarkus (JPA/Hibernate, CDI, Jakarta REST, H2), with a UML model at every step.

**The point of the project is the process, not the code.** Every line was generated by an AI model from a UML model or written instruction, 
and every generation was recorded: the prompt, the issues found, the corrections requested, and the unstated decisions the generator made. 
Where generated code revealed a gap in a model, the model was changed and the code regenerated — those are the documented round trips.

## Documentation

The record of the build lives in `docs/`:

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `docs/models/` | UML models (conceptual, specification, use cases, state chart, sequence, package) |
| `docs/prompts/` | One entry per prompt: the exact prompt, issues found, decisions accepted |
| `docs/prompts-output/` | The accepted code produced by each prompt |
| `docs/round-trips/` | One file per round trip: what was compared, what agreed, what didn't, what was done |

./mvnw quarkus:dev
